Table 4 summarizes our results on the XSum dataset. Recall that summaries in this dataset are highly abstractive (see Table 1) consisting of a sin- gle sentence conveying the gist of the document. Extractive models here perform poorly as corrob- orated by the low performance of the LEAD base- line (which simply selects the leading sentence from the document), and the ORACLE (which se- lects a single-best sentence in each document) in Table 4.
